**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 02:51  
[FACT] User has been getting into bird watching for about three months.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking to set up a bird feeder in their backyard.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended types of seed to attract a variety of birds:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. All-Purpose Seed Blend: A mix of millet, sunflower seeds, cracked corn, and safflower seeds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Wild Bird Seed Blend: Contains more sunflower seeds and nuts, attracting larger birds like woodpeckers and cardinals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Finch Blend: Includes nyjer seed, thistle, and millet, attracting finches, sparrows, and goldfinches.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Black Oil Sunflower Seeds: A favorite among cardinals, blue jays, and woodpeckers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Safflower Seeds: Less likely to attract squirrels and other mammals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Nyjer Seeds: Attracts finches, sparrows, and goldfinches.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Suet: A high-energy food for woodpeckers, nuthatches, and chickadees.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for bird feeders: Use fresh seeds, offer water, keep feeders clean, and be patient.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested keeping a bird journal to track species and behaviors.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering getting a feeder that can hold suet to attract woodpeckers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Benefits of offering suet:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Woodpeckers love suet, especially Downy and Hairy Woodpeckers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Suet attracts birds year-round, especially in winter.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Suet can attract other birds like nuthatches, chickadees, and titmice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for offering suet: Choose high-quality suet, position the feeder in partial shade, and keep it clean.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested dual-compartment feeders for offering both seed and suet.  
[PREFERENCE] User has been trying to spot a Red-headed Woodpecker but has had no luck.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suet may not attract Red-headed Woodpeckers, as they prefer insects, fruits, and seeds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID
